missing: A hands-on comparison of NAS units that hold 64GB or more: whether each really runs at 64GB despite Intel's limits, how well several VMs run, and whether passthrough works. It should also give current prices and a direct pick against the mini PC plus NAS option.
why: No major reviewer or authority appears. Only two niche sites answer the question: homelabpicks works from spec sheets and says it did no lab testing, and bitdoze is an affiliate comparison with dated prices. The rest are mini PC roundups, operating-system and RAM explainers, general build guides and thin listicles. The 64GB angle is almost unaddressed. A focused page on NAS boxes that can host VMs, with current prices, RAM ceilings and warranty notes, would stand out.
